name: Wildmere
description: Wildmere is an original voxel survival sandbox for macOS and Windows. Explore seeded worlds, mine and craft, light the dark and build a home on the edge of the mere.
pitch: An original voxel survival sandbox. Wander mist-hung forests, mine ore by torchlight and build a home on the edge of the mere.

about.title: Every block is yours to move.
body: Wildmere is a survival sandbox built one cubic metre at a time. Every world grows from a seed: grassland and birch woods, spruce and dark forest, sandstone desert, snowfields and still, mirror-dark lakes.

Gather what the land offers, work it at the bench and the furnace, push your torches deeper underground and build whatever you can picture. Wildmere is an independent project in early access for macOS and Windows, so expect rough edges, and expect each release to smooth a few of them.

spotlights.title: No two seeds alike
spotlights.body: Terrain is generated from a seed, column by column, so every world unfolds differently. Follow a river of ridgelines from grassland into spruce country and up to the snowline, then come home by the lakes.
spotlights.alt: Illustration: stepped voxel mountains at dusk above a still lake.

spotlights.title: Gather, craft, settle
spotlights.body: Fell oak, birch, spruce and dark wood, cut planks, and turn stone, sand and clay into something that keeps the weather out. A workbench and a furnace turn raw finds into tools and better materials.
spotlights.alt: Illustration: an isometric chunk of land with a small timber cabin, a tree and a pond at blue hour.

spotlights.title: Light the deep
spotlights.body: Below the dirt, the stone holds seams of coal, iron and gold. Carry torches down with you, and look out for glowcaps: pale mushrooms that light the caves they grow in.
spotlights.alt: Illustration: a cut-away chunk of earth showing ore seams and a cave lit by a torch and glowing mushrooms.

features.title: Seeded worlds
features.body: Share a seed and a friend gets the same valleys, coastlines and lakes.

features.title: Mine and build
features.body: Over forty kinds of block, from mossy cobblestone to clear glass.

features.title: Craft and smelt
features.body: Work materials at the workbench and fire them in the furnace.

features.title: Living wilds
features.body: Wildlife roams the forests and plains, and birds take to the sky.

features.title: Atmosphere
features.body: Drifting clouds, moving water and ambient soundscapes.

features.title: Native on Apple Silicon
features.body: A universal macOS build that runs natively on M-series and Intel Macs.
